claims.claim: 7-speed transverse dry dual-clutch transmission with electro-hydraulic mechatronic control unit and separate dry clutch pack assembly, maximum factory input torque rated at 250 Nm.
claims.source_organisation: Volkswagen AG / Audi AG Service Training
claims.customer_facing_wording: The DQ200 is a 7-speed dry dual-clutch gearbox designed for engines producing up to 250 Nm of torque.

claims.claim: 6-speed transverse wet multi-plate dual-clutch transmission with integrated mechatronic module operating in common transmission fluid circuit, maximum factory input torque rated at 350 Nm.
claims.customer_facing_wording: The DQ250 is a 6-speed wet dual-clutch gearbox using multi-plate clutches bathed in transmission fluid for higher-torque engines.

claims.claim: 7-speed transverse wet dual-clutch transmission developed for MQB platform applications, rated for up to 420 Nm input torque.
claims.customer_facing_wording: The DQ381 is a modern 7-speed wet dual-clutch transmission engineered for mid-to-high power engines on modern platforms.

claims.claim: Heavy-duty 7-speed transverse wet dual-clutch transmission designed for high-torque commercial (Transporter) and performance (RS3/TTRS) applications, rated up to 600 Nm.
claims.customer_facing_wording: The DQ500 is a heavy-duty 7-speed wet dual-clutch gearbox used in high-torque performance models and commercial vans.

claims.claim: 6-speed longitudinal automatic transmission featuring Lepelletier epicyclic gearset and integrated Mechatronik electro-hydraulic control module.
claims.customer_facing_wording: The ZF 6HP is a 6-speed longitudinal automatic transmission with an integrated electronic Mechatronic control unit.

claims.claim: 8-speed longitudinal automatic transmission utilising four planetary gearsets and five shift elements, engineered for stop-start compatibility with HIS (Hydraulic Impulse Storage).
claims.source_title: ZF 8HP Technical Product Information & Functional Principles
claims.source_reference: ZF 8HP Technical Documentation / BMW Training Manual ST810
claims.customer_facing_wording: The ZF 8HP is an advanced 8-speed automatic gearbox offering fast shifts, stop-start support, and high mechanical efficiency.

claims.claim: Under ZF TE-ML 11 operating instructions, passenger car 6HP and 8HP automatic transmissions are generally filled maintenance-free for standard use, but ZF recommends fluid and filter change after approximately 150,000 km, or earlier under severe operating conditions (high temperatures, high loads, sporty driving, or unknown history).
claims.source_title: ZF List of Lubricants TE-ML 11 / ZF Aftermarket Maintenance Guidance
claims.customer_facing_wording: ZF recommends fluid and filter servicing around 150,000 km (or earlier under arduous driving conditions) to maintain optimal shift quality.

claims.claim: 6-speed transverse wet dual-clutch transmission co-developed with Getrag, utilizing internal torsional damper springs immersed in transmission fluid for diesel and high-torque petrol models.
claims.source_title: Ford Technical Service Training: Powershift 6-Speed Dual-Clutch Transmission 6DCT450
claims.source_reference: Ford Training Course 307-011 / Getrag Technical Data MPS6
claims.customer_facing_wording: The 6DCT450 is a 6-speed wet dual-clutch gearbox used in 2.0L diesel and higher-torque Ford vehicles, featuring oil-bathed clutch plates and damper springs.

claims.claim: 6-speed transverse dry dual-clutch transmission manufactured by Getrag, actuated by external electromechanical Transmission Control Module (TCM) stepper motors.
claims.source_title: Ford Service Manual: DPS6 Dual Clutch Transmission Diagnosis & Actuation
claims.customer_facing_wording: The 6DCT250 is a 6-speed dry dual-clutch transmission used in smaller Ford models, operated by external electric shift actuators.

claims.claim: Continuously Variable Transmission featuring a dual-stage auxiliary sub-planetary gearbox combined with steel push belt and variable conical pulleys for small-capacity engines up to 1.6L.
claims.source_title: Jatco CVT7 Technical Overview & Engineering Principles
claims.source_organisation: Jatco Ltd / Nissan Motor Co., Ltd.
claims.source_reference: Jatco Engineering Bulletin JF015E / Nissan Service Manual TM-CVT7
claims.customer_facing_wording: The CVT7 is a compact continuously variable transmission combining variable pulleys with an auxiliary two-speed sub-gearbox for compact vehicles.

claims.claim: Mid-to-large capacity Continuously Variable Transmission with reduced friction losses, expanded ratio coverage, and electronic D-step shift logic simulation for engines up to 3.5L.
claims.source_title: Jatco CVT8 Product Documentation & Technical Specs
claims.source_reference: Jatco Technical Review No. 11 / Nissan Workshop Manual TM-CVT8
claims.customer_facing_wording: The CVT8 is Jatco's main Continuously Variable Transmission for mid-sized crossover SUVs, providing smooth step-less ratio changes.

claims.claim: 7-speed longitudinal automatic transmission featuring two Ravigneaux and one simple planetary gearsets, with fully integrated electronic transmission control unit (VGS) mounted inside oil sump.
claims.source_reference: Introduction into Service Manual 722.9 / WIS Document P-B-27.00/10
claims.customer_facing_wording: The 7G-Tronic (722.9) is a 7-speed automatic transmission with an integrated electronic conductor plate submerged in the oil sump.

claims.claim: 9-speed longitudinal automatic transmission with 4 planetary gearsets and 6 shift elements, featuring direct multi-solenoid hydraulic control and dual oil pumps (mechanical and electric auxiliary).
claims.source_reference: WIS Document P-B-27.00/22 / Introduction to Service NAG3
claims.customer_facing_wording: The 9G-Tronic (725.0) is Mercedes-Benz's 9-speed automatic transmission offering wide gear ratios, dual oil pumps, and high fuel efficiency.
